claim: Try sample data in one click and see a completed reconciliation.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open landing; click the primary sample action once; assert /demo, banner, completed result, reset, exit, and export

claim: Demo work uses a separate browser database and is discarded when the visitor starts for real.
sandbox: seed a marked real draft; enter and reset demo; exit; assert real draft unchanged and demo database deleted

claim: No account is required. The reconciliation flow sends no CSV data, analytics, or tracking requests.
sandbox: record every request during the completed demo and exports; assert every request is same-origin and no account action exists

claim: Each CSV must have headers, no more than 50,000 rows, and a size no greater than 10 MB.
sandbox: for each limit, open a dedicated fresh browser context; await the ready real workspace; submit one exact boundary fixture and assert its specific rejection

claim: A row-level CSV, accountant PDF, printable report, and JSON backup are available without a license.
sandbox: completed /demo without a license; inspect a known source row in CSV, PDF, print DOM, and JSON; intercept the print call

claim: The completed demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: dedicated new browser context; load /demo; wait for service worker; set that context offline; reload and assert completed result

claim: A real current draft remains after refresh on the same device.
sandbox: start at /demo; enter real mode; import an order events CSV; reload and assert its filename remains

claim: US $19 once adds named history and reusable mappings; reconciliation and exports remain free.
sandbox: enter real mode; activate a fixture license; reconcile and name work; save, reload, reopen, and delete history; save and apply a changed mapping preset; inspect both database stores

claim: The license token is stored in this browser and sent to Sociobot only for license checks; CSV contents are not sent.
sandbox: import a CSV containing a unique marker; mock verification; assert the GET contains only the token query value, no body or CSV marker, and the token is stored locally

claim: Payment opens on Sociobot's hosted checkout; this app does not load payment forms or receive card details.
sandbox: assert no card fields or external payment scripts in the app; intercept the exact product checkout navigation and assert a GET to the Sociobot URL

claim: Order events require date and amount; processor payouts require date and net amount; bank deposits require date and amount.
sandbox: clear each of the six required mappings in turn; assert its source-specific error; repair it and complete reconciliation

claim: Erase current draft removes the draft but keeps saved history.
sandbox: seed current draft and saved history; confirm erase; inspect IndexedDB stores

claim: The sample reconciles order events, the processor payout, and bank deposits with visible source rows and original values.
sandbox: completed /demo; assert totals and zero variance; inspect sample-events.csv row 2 for ORD-1001, its date, mapped amount, and original values

claim: The app has no bank connection, commerce connection, or ledger-posting action.
sandbox: start at /demo; open Home; assert scope text and absence of connection or posting controls

claim: The build creates an installable offline site in dist with every public route and service worker.
sandbox: open /demo, then assert built root, demo, legal, 404, and service-worker files exist and are nonempty
